title: A Multi-faceted Analysis of Cognitive Abilities: Evaluating Prompt Methods with Large Language Models on the CONSORT Checklist
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the performance, reasoning, and uncertainty calibration of Large Language Models in the context of clinical trial reporting standards (the CONSORT checklist). Although it mentions 'epistemic competence' (defined as self-assessment of knowledge limits) and 'epistemic reliability,' these are used as technical terms for machine learning calibration rather than for evaluating religious faith, spiritual traditions, theology, morals, or ethics.
